ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels and 40% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes; central low-intensity (black) region forming a wide 'V' shape extending from the base to the median notch. Fine low-intensity spotting is present within the white regions near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.3 relative to the lobe vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary with high-frequency serrations; significant jagged peaks are observed on the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer's right).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing margins, tapering into sharp, recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured circular pixel formations localized at the terminal distal points of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One vertical low-intensity linear mark on the interior of the left white lobe; one distinct high-intensity 'X' shaped linear anomaly in the central low-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white 'X' shaped scar is visible in the central dark region; a dark vertical linear mark is present on the left white lobe; heavy textured scarring at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme distal tips exhibit an unusually sharp, hook-like upward orientation.
